To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the presence of carbon is responsible for the superior electrochemical activity of LiFePO _{4} -based composites and that the presence of Nb is not necessary for this effect.

(i) the presence of Nb in LiFePO4 is not necessary for superior electrochemical performance, (ii) the presence of carbon in the LiFePO4 matrix is essential for good electrochemical performance and (iii) the presence of C and/or Nb in the LiFeFePO4 matrix does not necessarily lead to superior electrochemical activity.

the presence of carbon in the LiFePO4 structure is beneficial for the electrochemical activity of LiFePO 4-based electrodes, while the presence of Nb in the LiFeP04 structure has no effect on the electrochemical activity and only marginally affects the electrical conductivity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterization of LiFePO-based composites with improved electrochemical properties.
the synthesis of LiFePO3/C composites, which are electrochemically active and highly conductive.
the synthesis of LiFePO 4-based composites and the effect of the presence of Nb and/or carbon on their electrochemical and electrical properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of Nb- and C-containing precursors in the preparation of LiFePO 4 composites leads to a material with a superior electrical conductivity and electrochemical activity, but not to a doped material.
the presence of carbon in the LiFePO4 structure is the key to its electrochemical activity and that Nb doping is not a viable route to improve the electrical conductivity of LiFePO3-based composites.
the presence of carbon is the most important factor in determining the electrochemical activity of LiFePO 4 -based composites, while the role of Nb is not clear.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of carbon is essential for obtaining high Li+ conductivity and good electrochemical performance of LiFePO 4.
Nb-doped LiFePO4 can only be produced through a sol-gel method and that the electrochemical activity of LiFePO-based composites is strongly dependent on the presence of carbon.
